hypothesis: The R161 premise-aware Reporter repair will preserve the two R160 passing metrics while changing Q16 false-premise behavior, allowing the immutable 30-question cohort to meet all product thresholds in one new three-layer-live execution.

cohort.selection_rule: every frozen question exactly once on commit 7fd6727; no R160 state, saved states, rerun, best-of, supersession, silent exclusion, or cross-run splicing

decision_rules.pass: The one merged exact-once artifact has 30/30 status=done, three-layer live fidelity, no saved states, evidence_reachable_rate >= 0.60, orphaned_sub_questions == 0, and false_premise_failed == 0.
decision_rules.candidate_passes: Publish this artifact as the sole product proof and proceed to provider-free F15; do not execute another full cohort.
decision_rules.candidate_fails: Preserve the complete failed experiment, classify one defect class, change code, and treat any later full cohort as another independent candidate; never splice cases or metrics.

power_and_noise.rationale: This is a census of the immutable acceptance cohort and a threshold decision, not an A/B effect estimate.
power_and_noise.judge_samples_rationale: Formal metrics are deterministic reader-delivery and behavioral measurements; one judge sample retains runner integrity without repeated irrelevant judge variance.
power_and_noise.budget_coverage: R160 cost CNY 14.55970092; a CNY 48 round ceiling covers the same census and remains within the CNY 300 plan fuse.

stop_conditions: sum of the six shard ledgers reaches CNY 48
any shard reaches its CNY 8 fuse
credentials or third-party response bodies would leave ignored artifacts
a configuration error would violate exact-once, live-fidelity, or shard-ledger isolation before paid execution
rollback: Preserve every terminal and partial artifact, stop dependent paid work, and do not rerun, replace, or supersede a failed case on unchanged code.
